description: The gate set (the model owner's decision of 2026-09-20, Highlights 5.4, record 87 of docs/LOG_2026-09-20.md; chosen by measured coverage on 2026-09-20, the trimming plan, record 91): the worlds replayed at every commit of an integration through tools/run_series.py --list. Together they declare every key, table rule and family kind of the register, write every record kind, and execute every engine line any registered world reaches. The whole register replays only under --full or on demand. A new key or rule adds the first world that declares it, with the line it covers. ticks is the world's declared duration; cap is the interval by which the world's coverage is complete (the fast pass, --list --fast).
